message.beltworks.stretch_blocked: A block stands in the stretch's way.
message.beltworks.stretch_crosses_a_line: A line crosses the stretch here, and a stretch never cuts one. Raise it over the line and lower it past.
message.beltworks.slope_turns: A belt slope never turns, so this would not connect.
message.beltworks.wedge_blocked: A slope here needs a wedge under it, and only air, plants or snow can make way for one.
message.beltworks.rotate_slope: A belt on a slope cannot be turned: it would break the climb.
message.beltworks.rotate_splitter: A splitter cannot be turned in place.
message.beltworks.dismantle_off_line: That is not a tile of the line the dismantle started on.
item.beltworks.loader.tooltip: Moves 15 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.beltworks.improved_loader.tooltip: Moves 30 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.beltworks.express_loader.tooltip: Moves 45 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.beltworks.turbo_loader.tooltip: Moves 60 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
block.beltworks.loader.tooltip.1: [Right-Click] with an item to set it as filter.
block.beltworks.loader.tooltip.ftbfilter: Supports smart filters from the 'FTB Filters' mod.
item.beltworks.belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 15 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
item.beltworks.improved_belt_tile.toolti: One block of belt, carrying 30 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
item.beltworks.express_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 45 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
item.beltworks.turbo_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 60 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
